name: alibaba/qwen3.7-max
description: Qwen3.7 Max is the largest and most capable model in Alibaba's Qwen3.7 series as of its May 2026 release, a reasoning model built for agent-centric work and offered here with text input and output. Alibaba highlights its strengths in programming, office and productivity tasks, and long-running autonomous execution. Model Studio now lists the Qwen3.7 line as legacy and recommends Qwen3.8 Max for the strongest reasoning, so it fits workloads already validated on Qwen3.7 Max.
